value_or_rule: One successfully consumed beverage serving meeting predefined residual-liquid and usability criteria
justification: Item count alone does not establish functional equivalence
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Test alternative FU definitions and record failures/replacements

value_or_rule: For unchanged material, density, diameter, wall thickness, and end features, mass is proportional to length: M≈ρπDtL
justification: Thin-wall approximation supplied by project; suitable only for first-order screening
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Validate against measured masses for each design; do not apply across U/telescopic/straight or paper/plastic designs without geometry

value_or_rule: Use 10% only to demonstrate accounting, not as a feasible design
justification: No minimum functional length has yet been measured
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Sweep from 0% to experimentally supported limit; never label 10% feasible

value_or_rule: Treat supplier carton L×W×H as external rectangular volume
justification: Datasheets provide three orthogonal carton dimensions
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Model pallet/container integer packing separately; dimensional volume is not actual occupied transport volume

value_or_rule: Carton net mass / 2,500 straws = 1.10 g per straw
justification: Datasheet gives 10 packs × 250 and 2.75 kg carton net mass
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Confirm whether net mass excludes all inner packaging; do not use conflicting 'Package Weight: 3.3 g'

justification: Gross and net carton masses are listed
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Includes all packaging and possible rounding; validate with weighed carton components

justification: Datasheet lists approximate unit mass and outer-pack mass
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Treat as approximate; gross mass may include moisture/rounding and all packaging

value_or_rule: Do not scale transport emissions directly with straw mass savings
justification: Mass and volume constraints, integer packing, utilization, route, and packaging can dominate
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Model mass-constrained and volume-constrained cases separately

value_or_rule: Tetra Pak assumes identical functionality and equivalent ease of use for its 100 × 5 mm paper and plastic straws
justification: This is stated in the LCA and is not an independent user test
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Stress-test replacements, failure, residual liquid, and user acceptance

value_or_rule: No external height×width×depth or straw-hole coordinates are assigned to the Tetra Pak 200 mL case
justification: The reviewed Tetra Pak LCA provides surface area but not these dimensions
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Obtain a manufacturer keyline/CAD drawing or measure representative packs

justification: Requires container geometry, insertion point, liquid-access target, residual-liquid target, and mouth protrusion
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Bench and user testing across representative pack formats

value_or_rule: Do not convert laboratory wet-strength loss into an expected additional replacement rate or independent per-attempt failure probability
justification: Mechanical tests were not user trials and products vary
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Estimate attempt-level failure and additional straws per successful serving in timed beverage-use tests by liquid, temperature, duration, and product

value_or_rule: Detection does not establish intentional addition
justification: Raw material contamination, processing, recycled content, or treatment could contribute
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Use formulation/supply-chain evidence and total/targeted fluorine methods before causal claims

value_or_rule: Material concentration or extractable PFAS is not equivalent to beverage migration or human dose
justification: Only Timshina included a limited water-leaching experiment; other studies differ
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Migration tests under representative beverage chemistry, temperature, contact time, and straw surface area

value_or_rule: Core geometry conclusions must remain unchanged when PFAS discussion is removed
justification: Material-efficiency claim should not depend on a contaminant narrative
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Run manuscript logic check with PFAS section deleted

value_or_rule: Any shortening that changes hole, membrane, applicator, container wall, or packing must include those burdens
justification: Joint optimization can shift impacts from accessory to container/manufacturing
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Inventory tooling, line changes, reject rate, extra container material, and packaging effects

value_or_rule: Observed straw configurations are reference designs, not proven inefficient baselines
justification: No source establishes that supplied length exceeds the functional minimum
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Use optimization/validation to test slack before claiming inefficiency

value_or_rule: A fixed-wrapper scenario may be shown only as a conservative accounting case
justification: Wrapper and applicator geometry might not shrink with the straw
sensitivity_or_validation_required: Pair with redesigned-wrapper and zero-logistics-benefit scenarios
